landmarks.name: King Abdullah Financial District
landmarks.description: A cutting-edge financial hub spanning 1.6M sqm, anchoring Riyadh's role as a global financial center.
landmarks.significance: Home to the Saudi Central Bank, major financial institutions, and the future headquarters of regional banking.

landmarks.name: Kingdom Centre
landmarks.description: Riyadh's iconic 302m tower featuring a distinctive sky bridge and luxury shopping.
landmarks.significance: Architectural symbol of modern Saudi Arabia, mixed-use development integrating commerce, hospitality, and retail.

landmarks.name: Al Faisaliah Tower
landmarks.description: Saudi Arabia's first skyscraper at 267m, crowned with a distinctive golden sphere.
landmarks.significance: A pioneering architectural achievement that marked Riyadh's transformation into a modern metropolis.

landmarks.name: Olaya District
landmarks.description: The commercial heart of Riyadh, dense with corporate headquarters, hotels, and retail.
landmarks.significance: Central business district driving economic activity, hosting international corporations and embassies.

landmarks.name: Diplomatic Quarter
landmarks.description: A masterplanned district housing international embassies, mosques, and cultural institutions.
landmarks.significance: Architectural showcase blending Islamic design with modern urban planning, fostering international relations.

landmarks.name: King Fahd National Library
landmarks.description: A monumental repository of knowledge with millions of volumes and digital resources.
landmarks.significance: Cultural cornerstone preserving Saudi heritage and advancing scholarly research.

landmarks.name: King Abdullah Park
landmarks.description: One of Riyadh's largest urban parks featuring water fountains, walking trails, and green spaces.
landmarks.significance: Urban oasis providing recreational space and improving quality of life in the city center.

landmarks.name: Boulevard Riyadh City
landmarks.description: A vibrant entertainment and dining destination showcasing contemporary Saudi culture.
landmarks.significance: Symbol of Vision 2030's cultural transformation, blending leisure, commerce, and public engagement.

landmarks.name: Burj Rafal
landmarks.description: A 307m mixed-use tower with distinctive twin-spire design.
landmarks.significance: Architectural landmark contributing to Riyadh's evolving skyline.

landmarks.name: Tahlia Street
landmarks.description: Premier shopping and dining boulevard, Riyadh's equivalent to the Champs-Élysées.
landmarks.significance: Retail and lifestyle corridor reflecting cosmopolitan Saudi culture.
